blocks.text: Authentication Service administrators can skip two-factor authentication (2FA) for a short duration and use only their password to log in to the subscribed Zscaler service. For example, if a user does not have the device on which they receive the one-time passcode (OTP) for authentication, they can be allowed to skip 2FA temporarily.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Authentication > Users.
On the Users page, click the Edit icon for the required user.
On the Edit User page, click the Security Settings section.
Under Multi-Factor Bypass, enable Skip Second Factor Authentication.
The Skip Until field appears, displaying the current date and time. By default, the MFA can be skipped for 8 hours. Click to select a different date and time. The maximum limit is 5 days.
The Skip Second Factor Authentication option is only available for hosted admins and not for admins authenticating via the external Identity provider (IdP).
